name: Hilkiah
overview: Hilkiah was a male Levite known as the second-born son of Hosah. His identification within the tribe of Levi situates him among the priestly and temple-serving families, though no additional notes expand on his life or role beyond this lineage detail.
namesAndTitles: The name Hilkiah means 'YHWH is [my] portion,' reflecting a personal acknowledgment of the Lord as his inheritance and portion. This proper name, recorded in 1 Chronicles 26:11, carries a theologically rich meaning common among Levites, emphasizing devotion to God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Hilkiah as the son of Hosah. Beyond this father-son relationship, no other family connections are documented for Hilkiah in the biblical text provided.
scriptureSignificance: Hilkiah's significance lies primarily in his genealogical placement within the Levitical line, specifically as Hosah's second son. This positioning underlines the continuity of Levitical service and heritage, which was crucial for maintaining the temple worship system established by God. While no further narrative details are given, his mention preserves the integrity of the priestly lineage.
